# DaveHarness capabilities manifest

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_capabilities_manifest.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated from DaveLLM's tool registry by `scripts/generate_capabilities_manifest.py`. The same data is in [DAVEHARNESS_CAPABILITIES.json](DAVEHARNESS_CAPABILITIES.json). Do not edit either file: change the code, then run `python scripts/generate_capabilities_manifest.py`. Tests fail when the committed files are stale.

DaveLLM `2.1.0` · DaveHarness `1.0.0-rc.1` · manifest version 1

## Summary

- 21 tools with every flag on: 5 from `DAVE_ENABLE_TOOLS`, 1 from `DAVE_ENABLE_SHELL_TOOL`, 15 from `DAVE_ENABLE_EXTENDED_TOOLS`.
- Exact-call approval required: `file.append`, `file.edit`, `file.write`, `shell.exec`.
- Tools by permission: `execute_process` 1; `public_network` 1; `read` 4; `read_files` 10; `read_system` 2; `write_files` 3.
- Every tool schema rejects unknown arguments (`additionalProperties: false`).
- Definition fingerprints are not listed: they depend on the checkout path and Python version. `tests/fixtures/davellm/tool_catalog.json` pins their portable inputs.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Tools | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DAVE_ENABLE_TOOLS` | `false` | `file.append`, `file.read`, `file.write`, `system.info`, `web.fetch` | Turns on tool execution and the core tools. |
| `DAVE_ENABLE_SHELL_TOOL` | `false` | `shell.exec` | Registers shell.exec. Execution still needs DAVE_ENABLE_TOOLS. |
| `DAVE_ENABLE_EXTENDED_TOOLS` | `false` | `chat.search`, `cluster.status`, `file.edit`, `file.list`, `file.read_lines`, `file.search`, `git.diff`, `git.log`, `git.show`, `git.status`, `md.outline`, `md.section`, `project.artifacts`, `project.brain.read`, `project.notepad.read` | Registers the extended tools: bounded reads, plus file.edit, which needs approval for every call. Honored only with DAVE_ENABLE_TOOLS. |
| `DAVE_TOOL_ROOTS` | `[]` | — | JSON array of absolute folders that file and Git tools may use. |

### chat.search

Search your own earlier DaveLLM conversations and return short matching snippets.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | maxLength `200`, minLength `1` | — |
| `max_results` | integer or null | no | default `5`, maximum `10`, minimum `1` | — |

### cluster.status

Show which configured DaveLLM nodes are reachable and which models they are known to serve.

No arguments.

### file.append

Append UTF-8 text inside an allowed tool root.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | minLength `1` | — |
| `content` | string | yes | — | — |

### file.edit

Replace exact text in an existing UTF-8 text file inside an allowed tool root. old_text must occur exactly expected_count times (default 1), or nothing is written. Needs the user's approval, which shows the text before and after.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | maxLength `4096`, minLength `1` | Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it. |
| `old_text` | string | yes | maxLength `20000`, minLength `1` | The exact text to replace, copied from the file. |
| `new_text` | string | yes | maxLength `20000` | The replacement text; empty deletes old_text. |
| `expected_count` | integer or null | no | default `1`, maximum `100`, minimum `1` | How many times old_text occurs; any other count refuses the edit. |

### file.list

List files and folders inside an allowed tool root, sorted by name, with paging. Paths are shown relative to the tool root.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string or null | no | default `.`, maxLength `4096`, minLength `1` | Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it. |
| `depth` | integer or null | no | default `1`, maximum `3`, minimum `0` | 0 describes the path itself; 1 lists its direct children. |
| `max_entries` | integer or null | no | default `100`, maximum `500`, minimum `1` | — |
| `cursor` | string or null | no | maxLength `64`, minLength `1` | next_cursor from the previous page of the same request. |

### file.read

Read a UTF-8 text file inside an allowed tool root.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | minLength `1` | — |

### file.read_lines

Read up to 400 numbered lines from a UTF-8 text file inside an allowed tool root. Lines start at 1; use next_start_line to continue.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | maxLength `4096`, minLength `1` | Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it. |
| `start_line` | integer or null | no | default `1`, maximum `10000000`, minimum `1` | — |
| `max_lines` | integer or null | no | default `200`, maximum `400`, minimum `1` | — |

### file.search

Find lines containing literal text in UTF-8 files inside an allowed tool root. Binary files and files over 1 MiB are skipped.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | maxLength `200`, minLength `1` | — |
| `path` | string or null | no | default `.`, maxLength `4096`, minLength `1` | Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it. |
| `case_sensitive` | boolean or null | no | default `false` | — |
| `max_matches` | integer or null | no | default `50`, maximum `200`, minimum `1` | — |

### file.write

Write UTF-8 text inside an allowed tool root.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | minLength `1` | — |
| `content` | string | yes | — | — |

### git.diff

Show a unified diff for a Git working tree inside an allowed tool root: working-tree changes by default, staged changes with staged=true, or the changes between from_revision and to_revision (default HEAD). Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string or null | no | default `.`, maxLength `4096`, minLength `1` | A Git working tree folder, relative to the tool root or absolute inside it. |
| `staged` | boolean or null | no | default `false` | — |
| `from_revision` | string or null | no | maxLength `128`, minLength `1` | A branch, tag, commit hash, or HEAD, optionally followed by ~N or ^N. |
| `to_revision` | string or null | no | maxLength `128`, minLength `1` | A branch, tag, commit hash, or HEAD, optionally followed by ~N or ^N. |

### git.log

List up to 50 recent commits of a Git working tree inside an allowed tool root, newest first, with short hash, date, author, and subject. Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string or null | no | default `.`, maxLength `4096`, minLength `1` | A Git working tree folder, relative to the tool root or absolute inside it. |
| `limit` | integer or null | no | default `20`, maximum `50`, minimum `1` | — |
| `file` | string or null | no | maxLength `1024`, minLength `1` | A file path relative to the repository. |

### git.show

Show one commit of a Git working tree inside an allowed tool root, with its message and patch, or one file's text at that commit when file is given. Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string or null | no | default `.`, maxLength `4096`, minLength `1` | A Git working tree folder, relative to the tool root or absolute inside it. |
| `revision` | string | yes | maxLength `128`, minLength `1` | A branch, tag, commit hash, or HEAD, optionally followed by ~N or ^N. |
| `file` | string or null | no | maxLength `1024`, minLength `1` | A file path relative to the repository. |

### git.status

Show the branch, ahead/behind counts, and staged, unstaged, untracked, and conflicted files of a Git working tree inside an allowed tool root. Read only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string or null | no | default `.`, maxLength `4096`, minLength `1` | A Git working tree folder, relative to the tool root or absolute inside it. |

### md.outline

List the headings of a Markdown file inside an allowed tool root, in order, with their levels and line numbers. Headings inside code fences are ignored.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | maxLength `4096`, minLength `1` | Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it. |
| `max_headings` | integer or null | no | default `200`, maximum `500`, minimum `1` | — |

### md.section

Read the lines under one heading of a Markdown file inside an allowed tool root, up to 400 lines. The heading must match exactly, ignoring case; use next_start_line with file.read_lines to continue a long section.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | maxLength `4096`, minLength `1` | Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it. |
| `heading` | string | yes | maxLength `500`, minLength `1` | The heading text, without the leading # marks. |
| `include_subsections` | boolean or null | no | default `true` | false stops at the first subheading. |

### project.artifacts

List the saved artifacts of the project this run belongs to, or read one artifact's text by passing its identifier as artifact.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact` | string or null | no | maxLength `100`, minLength `1` | An artifact identifier from the list; omit it to list. |
| `max_entries` | integer or null | no | default `20`, maximum `50`, minimum `1` | — |

### project.brain.read

Read the BRAIN (pinned, active, and recent project memory) of the project this run belongs to, as it was when the run started.

No arguments.

### project.notepad.read

Read the plain-text notepad of the project this run belongs to.

No arguments.

### shell.exec

Execute one command from the fixed safe-command allowlist.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | string | yes | minLength `1` | — |

### system.info

Read bounded operating system and Python runtime information.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | no | enum `["all", "platform", "platform_version", "python_version", "processor"]` | — |

### web.fetch

Fetch a bounded public HTTP or HTTPS text response.

| Argument | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | minLength `1` | — |

## Runs

### Lifecycle run request

Body of `POST /tools/agent/runs`. Validators in `app.py` add checks not listed here, such as the number and size of `messages`.

| Field | Required | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `messages` | yes | — | — |
| `node_id` | yes | — | max_length `128`, min_length `1` |
| `model` | yes | — | max_length `128`, min_length `1` |
| `project_id` | no | `null` | max_length `128` |
| `conversation_id` | no | `null` | max_length `128` |
| `max_tokens` | no | `2048` | ge `1`, le `262144` |
| `temperature` | no | `0.7` | ge `0`, le `2` |
| `step_limit` | no | `8` | ge `1`, le `32` |
| `error_budget` | no | `2` | ge `1`, le `8` |

### Decision request

Body of `POST /tools/agent/runs/{run_id}/decisions`.

| Field | Required | Default | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `call_id` | yes | — | max_length `256`, min_length `1` |
| `digest` | yes | — | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `definition_fingerprint` | yes | — | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `permission` | yes | — | max_length `80`, min_length `1` |
| `nonce` | yes | — | max_length `128`, min_length `1` |
| `decision` | yes | — | enum `["approve", "reject"]` |

### Run budget

Lifecycle runs start from these defaults, with `model_steps` and `errors` taken from the request's `step_limit` and `error_budget`. The legacy `/tools/agent/run` and `/tools/agent/resume` routes keep their original step and error limits only. `null` means no limit.

| Limit | Lifecycle runs | Legacy routes |
|---|---|---|
| `model_steps` | `8` | `8` |
| `errors` | `2` | `2` |
| `tool_calls` | `32` | `null` |
| `total_wall_seconds` | `300.0` | `null` |
| `tool_output_bytes` | `65536` | `null` |
| `transcript_bytes` | `2097152` | `null` |
| `event_count` | `1000` | `null` |

### Payload limits

DaveHarness's default ceiling for any JSON payload it admits.

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| `max_bytes` | `16777216` |
| `max_depth` | `32` |
| `max_nodes` | `100000` |
